TimeIndex Factory API Reference¶

Back to PlussQit API Reference

This reference teaches the free functions in pluss::timeindex. These functions create and render the one-dimensional temporal axis consumed by search, slicing, rolling, resampling, and alignment operations. Instance behavior remains in the Timeline Index Accessor API Reference.

Choose By Source¶

  • Use make for timestamp text, exact epoch nanoseconds, or an existing one-dimensional Timeline. pluss::make_timeindex(...) is its intentional root-level forwarding spelling and is taught on the same page because its contract is identical.

  • Use date_range for a regular, endpoint-inclusive temporal axis.

  • Use from_buffer when an external owner supplies signed 64-bit epoch-nanosecond storage and an ownership callback.

  • Use print for structural diagnostic text; use TimeIndex stream insertion when default formatting is sufficient.

Construction checks for NaT, rank, and non-decreasing order by default. require_sorted=false is an explicit low-level escape for workflows that must first inspect or reorder an axis; ordered lookup, rolling, and resampling still require an increasing axis.

Every displayed result in this family is emitted by examples/CodeH/timeindex_factory_reference_demo.cpp. Its checked-in transcript is docs/sphinx/_verified/timeindex_factory_reference_output.txt.
